written_before: any relevance judgement was made; the 24 citations were already recorded in docs/phase1_provenance_results_2026-11-24.jsonl (provenance PASS 24/24) but have NOT yet been scored for relevance
question: Does the text the council cites actually ADDRESS the proposal, or is it decoration that merely exists?
items: 12 dev proposals x 2 citations each = 24 judgements. Citation text is the 160-240 char snippet stored in phoenix_evidence; the judge sees the snippet, never the verdict.

rubric.DIRECT: the snippet names or discusses the proposal's actual subject matter (same object/operation/policy being proposed)
rubric.TANGENTIAL: same domain or vocabulary as the proposal but does not address the specific subject
rubric.UNRELATED: the snippet is about something else entirely; citing it would mislead a reader
rubric.UNGRADED: the judge returned nothing parseable - recorded and counted SEPARATELY, never folded into a pass

judge.model: gpt-oss-20b-MXFP4 on :8587 (the same resident model the council votes with)
judge.blindness: the judge is shown the proposal topic and the snippet only; the verdict, the agent names and the vote tallies are withheld
judge.determinism: temperature 0, one call per citation, no retries on disagreement; a non-parseable reply is UNGRADED
judge.known_limitation: this is MODEL-graded, not human-graded, and the grader is the same model family that produced the votes. It can share the council's blind spots, so a PASS means 'a local judge reading only the text says these citations are on-topic', not 'a human verified relevance'.

cross_check.method: mechanical key-term overlap: share of the proposal's content words (len>4, minus stopwords) that also appear in the snippet
cross_check.role: reported beside every judgement; if mechanical overlap says 'no shared vocabulary' while the model says DIRECT, that disagreement is printed as a warning rather than resolved silently

decision_rule.PASS: at least 18 of 24 (75%) of the GRADED citations are DIRECT
decision_rule.FAIL: fewer than 18 DIRECT; the distribution is reported as measured and the gate stays failed
decision_rule.why_75pct: a citation that at least names the proposal's own subject means retrieval is on-topic; below three quarters, most citations are decoration and the evidence block is not doing the work the votes imply
decision_rule.ungraded_rule: UNGRADED citations reduce the denominator only if fewer than 3 of 24; at 3 or more the run is INVALID and must be re-run, because an unknown share of the evidence would be unassessed
